events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Cursed Elopement

options.text: My foolish son must return the princess.
Keep the girl, as is our right.
Release the princess, and exile my son.
The princess must be returned, but use this as a teachable moment for our wayward son.

events.text: A warning arrives from the [rival]. In a recent voyage abroad, your son [character] eloped with a [rival] princess, and now he refuses to return her. The court is divided. If your son keeps the princess, the nation will be plunged into War, but bowing to foreign threats will embolden our enemies.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Faithful Husband

options.text: Take [character], the [religion] suitor, as your husband.

events.text: It is no small secret that the followers of [religion] and [religion] are each hoping that you will take a bride of their own religion. The nobles supporting each religion have brought their favored suitors to court, in hopes that one may catch your eye. Will you accept either as a match?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Faithful Husband
events.text: The [family] family have brought you an offer of marriage, suggesting that [character] should marry [character], a good [religion] man. The presumptive nobles have already received the blessings of the. Will the wedding bells ring?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Family Meal

options.text: Use your shared faith to paint [character] as a dangerous radical.
Allow the marriage to go ahead.
In no uncertain terms, tell [character] to leave.

events.text: At a feast to celebrate the spring harvest, your [relative] is accompanied by [character], a lesser known noble. Throughout the evening you are surprised by the man's extreme [religion] faith which he loudly pushes on others at the table, unafraid to leap into arguments about differences in doctrine or religious interpretation. At the end of the night, [character] reveals that he brought [character] as an introduction and that he intends to be married to the zealot.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Little Pushback

options.text: He will do it for the good of the nation.
We can find him a better match.
Leverage our relationship with him to get him to agree. This provides an excellent lesson in statecraft.

events.text: The [family] family has offered a suitor, [character], for your son, but [character] refuses the proposed match. How shall we handle this situation?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Self Made Man

options.text: Placate the families with shows of gratitude for their understanding.

events.text: News arrives that [relative] [character] has asked to be wed to [character], a self-made man who has made his fortune through the building and supplying of trading vessels. Such a relation will bring a large dowry, but the snub would undoubtedly anger the noble families. Shall the marriage be permitted?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: An Oath of Support

options.text: “Very well, I will swear this oath.”
Refuse to bind yourself to the [family] family.

events.text: [character] of the [family] approaches with a proposition. “[character], we have a unique chance to help each other. I understand that more troops may be needed for the war, but in return I want an oath that you will help the [family] should we ever ask for aid.” The [family] are offering a husband and an impressive dowry. Is it worth making a promise with unknown consequences though?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Connections versus Relations

outcomes.label: Marriage Offer Tribe Peace Tribe Offer New
Marriage Offer Tribe Peace Tribe Offer

events.text: For a long time the [family] family have expected to marry one of their scions to [character], but more recently the [tribe] have offered to formalize our peaceful dealings if one of their women can marry [character] instead. While our agreement with the [family] was informal, breaking it would still have some repercussions. On the other hand, making peace with the [tribe] could have many benefits.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Connections versus Wealth
events.text: For a long time the [family] family have expected to marry one of their scions to [character], but more recently a rich merchant has offered a large incentive to marry one of his children to him instead. While our agreement with the [family] was informal, breaking it would still have some repercussions. Then again, money has all sorts of uses.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Courting Power

options.text: Consider the [family] present and future secured.
You do not have the leverage you think you do, [character].

events.text: [character] makes clear, he and the [family] have no intention of being sidelined in the rise of [rival]. [character] desires a presence in the [city] royal palace, and insists that means your heir [character] marrying [character], an up-and-coming young [family] suitor.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Daughter of [city]

options.text: [character] ties would give the perfect pretext for bringing [city] into [rival].
Even [character] presence is a diplomatic disaster waiting to happen. We must tread carefully indeed.

events.text: [city], and [character] parents, have a history in [rival]. They formed one of the most pointed threats to the reign of [character] before finally being subdued. And now an opportunity has landed in the [rival] court. [character] has escaped [rival] and seeks the hand of [character] in marriage.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Elephant Diplomacy

options.text: This is too dear a price.
Send [character] elephants untrained in the art of war.

events.text: The [rival] have made no secret of their admiration of the [rival] use of elephants in warfare. Desiring such troops of his own, [character] has made an offer of marriage between [character] and [character], the most sought after hand in [rival], in return for your trained [unit].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Heart in Two

options.text: I will not be marrying at this time.

events.text: A proposal has arrived from the [family] family, offering their son [character] as a suitor. A marriage with one of the houses would help governance and give support. Upon hearing of the proposal, [character] rushes to you, begging for you not to accept. Before you lie three paths. Duty, love or the unknown. Which will you tread?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Improbable Tasks

options.text: They must yoke a lion and boar to a chariot.
Only those who hunt an incredible beast will be allowed.
Send them to the market for a cup of wine.

events.text: Suitors are starting to line up for [character] hand, but your child will not be given to just anyone! Your genius mind starts to invent tasks for suitors to complete that will weed out the best of them.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Impudent Match

options.text: Send the heir away. He will forget him in time.
Let [rival] complain. I want the heir to be happy.

events.text: The heir, [character], has insisted on marrying [character] of [rival]. However, this pairing could trouble our friends in [rival] and have lasting political repercussions. What shall we do?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: The court has received a new marriage proposal: [character] and [character]. What is your answer?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A marriage proposal has arrived from the [family] family for [relative] [character]. How shall we respond to their suggestions?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A marriage proposal has arrived from the [family] family for [relative] [character]. How shall we respond to their suggestions?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A marriage proposal has arrived from the [family] family for [relative] [character]. How shall we respond to their suggestions?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A marriage proposal has arrived from the [family] family for [relative] [character]. How shall we respond to their suggestions?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: Emphasizing the importance of strengthening [rival], the [family] have proposed a marriage with [relative] [character]. Shall our two families be bound together?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A marriage proposal has arrived from the [family] family for [relative] [character]. How shall we respond to their suggestions?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A delegation from [rival] arrives with a marriage proposal for [relative] [character]. We should consider it carefully.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A delegation from [rival] arrives with a marriage proposal for [relative] [character]. We should consider it carefully.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A delegation from [rival] arrives with a marriage proposal for [relative] [character]. We should consider it carefully.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A delegation from our noble allies in [rival] arrives with two suitors for [relative] [character] hand in marriage. Shall it be a match?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Marriage Offer

options.text: This marriage is a matter of diplomacy, and above the [family]' petty squabbles.
We should not miss this opportunity to keep the families happy.

events.text: The [rival] party arrives in a show of splendor, bedecked in purple and gold. They have arrived to offer [character] as a potential husband for [relative] [character]. Before the [rival] have had a chance to dismount, a group from the already angry [family] charge in, shouting that [character] would be far more suitable. Neither side looks ready to stand down. Are either of these suitors suitable for [character]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: A group of [religion] have found two potential suitors for your hand, claiming that it is vital that you wed someone of the faith. Would [character] or [character] make a worthy husband, or should the and their candidates be turned away?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: To the court's surprise, a marriage proposal has arrived from the [tribe]: [relative] [character] and [character]. How shall we respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Marriage Offer

options.text: Ignore the [family]' intolerance and take [character] as husband.

events.text: A delegation has arrived from the [tribe], offering the hand of [character] to strengthen the bonds between your people. However, upon hearing of the offer, the [family] exclaim that it would be a disgrace for the leader of [rival] to marry a [tribe] over one of their own. They offer [character] as an alternative suitor and ask that you marry into their family instead. Who will you choose?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: To the court's surprise, a marriage proposal has arrived from the [tribe]: [relative] [character] and [character]. How shall we respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Marriage Offer
events.text: The [tribe] delegation rides into the city, carrying a marriage proposal from their leaders. They suggest that [character] or [character] would make a good husband for [relative] [character]. What will the reply be?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer

outcomes.label: Marriage Offer Two Families No New

events.text: A new marriage proposal for [relative] [character] has arrived from the [family] and [family] families. We should consider how this will affect the court. What do you suggest?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Marriage Offer

outcomes.label: Marriage Offer Two Families No New

events.text: A new marriage proposal for [relative] [character] has arrived from the [family] and [family] families. We should consider how this will affect the court. What do you suggest?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Marriage Proposal

options.text: Sadly, marriage is not to be.
My heir would make a good spouse.

events.text: The [family] family reaches out to schedule a private dinner. During the meal, they propose that one of the [family] sons would make a great match for you, or for your heir. How will you respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Marrying for Love

options.text: I have a duty to make the best match for [rival].

events.text: The time that you have with [character] is all too short, fleeting moments captured between your duties, covert glances and smiles when you pass. This is one such perfect moment. [character] traces patterns on your back as you recline in your chambers, speaking of how you wish every day could be like this. “Why can’t it be? You are the leader of [rival]. We could be together always if you just say the word.” It would damage your reputation forgoing a political marriage, but he is right. There is nothing stopping the union if you will it. Will you marry for love?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Matchmaker

options.text: I will marry when I am ready.

events.text: It has not gone unnoticed. You grow weary of ruling alone. Some of the court ministers have volunteered to find suitable prospects with whom to share your throne. What do you desire in a suitable companion?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Matchmaker
events.text: The war with the [tribe] has gone on long enough. You may wish to consider peace. Our spies report that one of the [tribe] warlords seeks mates for his sons. A match with your heir, [character], may be the solution to all of our problems. Shall we make this happen?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Matchmaker

options.text: The [tribe] suitor is difficult to resist.
The [family] family offers the best match.
I have no interest in marrying.

events.text: You must be weary of walking this world alone. The matchmaker suggests that it is time to seek a suitable partner to help you rule. May they interest you in an arranged marriage?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Midnight Meeting

options.text: Do nothing. This does not feel right.
Arrange to meet her in the gardens.
Alert the palace guard of this privacy breach.

events.text: Lately, a comely young servant girl has caught your eye, lingering in the background at courtly events. She is clearly beguiled by your reputation as a wild romantic. One evening, you find a message slipped beneath your chamber door: "Meet in the royal gardens."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Only the Finest

requirements.label: High Discipline
tip: The leader must have High Discipline

options.text: They shall marry, but I won't tolerate any frivolous wastes of the budget.

events.text: [character] beauty and refined tastes have made him one of the most eligible bachelors in [rival], and a natural match for crown heir [character]. Of course, that means the [family] will be expecting only the finest of lifestyles for the royal couple.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Protocol Marriage
events.text: A difficult decision lies before you. Breaking all protocol, both [rival] and [rival] have sent an offer of marriage for [relative] [character]. Would [character] be more suitable? Or perhaps [character] would be preferred? Either way, the rejected nation is unlikely to be pleased.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Oligarch's Betrothed

options.text: [character] is more suited to be a king.
I will not stand in the way of their marriage.

events.text: [character] is to be wed and has invited you to preside over the marriage. Upon meeting the intended, [character], you are taken by his incredible charm. In your brief time together, it appears that [character] reciprocates the attraction. Being shockingly frank, he asks if you would marry him instead. As the leader of [rival], you could take [character] as your own husband, but it would certainly make an enemy of [character].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: To Wed a [title]

options.text: Gladly accept to be joined in marriage.

events.text: An offer of marriage has arrived from [tribe], proposing that you should be wed to none other but [character]. The court will frown upon having such close ties to [tribe], but the bond would greatly strengthen relations with the tribe. Will you accept?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Under his Spell

options.text: This power is dangerous, send [character] into exile.

events.text: Your child [character] has found the man he wants to make his husband. The would-be groom is [character], an estranged member of the [family]. [character] warns that [character] is known to be a practicer of magic. Although often helpful, such power from the gods is easily corrupted and [character] suggests that [character] is probably under a spell so [character] can climb the ranks.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Wayward Son
events.text: [character] comes before you today with a proposal to marry [relative] [character] to [character]. “Due to events which I won’t get into right now, I would take it as a personal favor if you would take him off of our hands,” he says in conclusion.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Young and In Love

options.text: Refuse to entertain this marriage offer.

events.text: Returning from a tour of the nation, [relative] [character] bounds into the hall, unable to hide his unbound glee. Without prompting, he quickly introduces you to [character], an old childhood friend whom he happened to meet again on his travels. The two traveled together for the rest of the journey and are now clearly in love. [character] asks for permission to marry [character], but an advisor informs you that the [family] family had high hopes that [character] would make a match with someone from their family. Shall the marriage be allowed, or is the risk of angering the nobles too high?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [character] Price

options.text: A fair price, all things considered.
This is one request I cannot grant, [character].

events.text: [character] has, at last, made clear exactly what he has been angling at. [character] should wed [character], heir to the [rival] throne, paving the way for [family] ascendancy.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [religion] Suitor
events.text: [character] has made it his mission to find you a suitable [religion] bride, looking throughout [rival] and beyond. He eagerly presents [character], a potential match he found. What is your answer?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [rival] wife?

options.text: Some things are more important than [rival] goodwill.

events.text: [rival] sends its compliments. Quite a lot of them, in fact. [character] waxes poetic at every opportunity about everything from your taste in dinner decor to your flawless eyebrows. Flattery, promises, enthusiasm - [character] offers all in copious quantities... and yet, somehow, that very intensity puts you ill at ease. [character] perfunctory attempts at courtship feel almost a relief, by contrast.
